unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፬ — Meraf 4: Grand Master of ሰ and ሸ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ሰ and ሸ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የሰ እና የሸ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: SENSELAT
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'SENSELAT' (Chain) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ሸረሪት
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Spider' (Shererit). Find the correct missing last letter: ሸረሪ[ ? ].
games.tips_en: The full word is ሸረሪት (pronounced She-re-ri-t).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 2nd form ➔ 4th form ➔ [ ? ] (6th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ሰንሰለት
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Chain (Senselat)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with first-form 'ሰ', then sixth-form 'ን', followed by 'ሰ', first-form 'ለ', and end with sixth-form 'ት'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: SHERERIT
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'SHERERIT' (Spider) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ስ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the native 6th form 'S' sound of the ሰ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ሰዓት
games.instructions_en: Form the Amharic word for Clock or Hour (Seat)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 1st form 'ሰ', followed by throat 4th form 'ዓ', and end in 6th form 'ት'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: SEAT
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'SE'AT' (Clock/Hour) with the correct Amharic word.
